$comment: X-01 DEMO directory-pin fixture — the pilot stand-in for the EU-governed EDD DirectoryRecord.authorized_seal_keys. Each record pins, per UID, the seal key(s) authorised to seal that entity's BW-MED/ORG/MEMBER discovery documents. LINT-TRUST-05 rejects a discovery seal whose key is not pinned for its own UID (a valid QSealC authorised for another UID cannot seal here). DEMO scope: the pin is the raw seal-key spki_sha256 (SHA-256 of the entity-admin Ed25519 public key); production pins the QSealC x5t#S256 and additionally validates the chain to an EU Trusted List (a production-verifier duty, docs/production-verifier-architecture.md). The two demo entities share the single demo entity-admin key, so both pin the same spki_sha256; a real deployment pins each entity's own key.

registry_seal_keys.$comment: D6: the EDD core registry's OWN signing key - the anchor for STATUS-v1 assertions (LINT-DISC-25). Demo raw spki; production pins the registry QSealC x5t#S256 via the Trusted List.
